d=json.load(sys.stdin)
now=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

for e in recent: print(e["lastTimestamp"], e["involvedObject"]["name"], e["reason"], e["message"][:80])
'; echo "=== final state ==="; kubectl -n default get deploy app; kubectl -n default get pods -l app=app -o custom-columns='NAME:.metadata.name,READY:.status.containerStatuses[0].ready,RESTARTS:.status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount'"}
